defs.version: motion 1.0 (2026-08-14) — POST-HOC, exploratory, NOT part of the frozen five
defs.status: added after corpus completion; see PREREGISTRATION.md amendment A6
defs.provenance: implements the paired motion control of VBench's Dynamic Degree (Huang et al. 2023), which uses RAFT optical flow and the mean of the largest 5% of flows
defs.flow_model: torchvision RAFT (raft_small, C_T_V2 weights — Chairs+Things, the only pretrained pair torchvision ships for raft_small); Farneback (OpenCV) fallback recorded in output when used
defs.analysis_resize: bilinear, aspect preserved, both frames of a pair resized identically; RAFT requires dims divisible by 8 so dims are rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8
defs.flow_statistic: mean of per-pixel flow magnitudes at or above the 95th percentile (i.e. the largest 5%), per consecutive sampled frame pair
defs.headline: median of the per-pair series, in px/frame at analysis resolution
defs.headline_normalised: median_px divided by min(H, W) of the analysis grid — dimensionless, comparable across native grids
defs.static_threshold_note: no static/non-static threshold is baked in; VBench thresholds for a model-level proportion, whereas we keep the continuous value and let the analysis choose. Any threshold used downstream must be declared there.
